user.title: Set up MedTrack
user.description: Global reminder settings. Medications are added afterwards from the integration page.

data_description.notify_targets: Companion App notify services. Every reminder goes to all selected phones.
data_description.reremind_interval: Minutes between repeated reminders while a dose is unconfirmed.
data_description.max_reminders: Total reminders per dose, including the first. After the last one the dose is marked missed.
data_description.snooze_length: Minutes the Snooze button delays the next reminder.
data_description.early_take_window: How many minutes before the scheduled time a dose may already be confirmed.
data_description.interruption_level: How normal reminders break through Focus modes on iOS.
data_description.require_unlock: The phone must be unlocked before "Taken" is accepted.
data_description.critical_volume: Volume (0.1 to 1.0) of critical alerts, which sound even when the phone is muted.
data_description.history_retention: Days to keep dose history. 0 keeps it forever.

abort.no_notify_targets: No Companion App phones found. Install the Home Assistant app on your iPhone, sign in and allow notifications, then try again.

data_description.unit: For example tablet, capsule or ml. Also used for the stock.
data_description.times: Local times of day for each dose.
data_description.instructions: Optional, for example "with food". Shown in the reminder.
data_description.current_stock: Optional. How much you have now, in the unit above. Leave empty to not track stock for this medication.
data_description.low_stock_threshold: Optional. Alert when stock is at or below this amount. Leave empty for no low-stock alerts.
data_description.critical_mode: Critical alerts sound even when the phone is muted or in a Focus mode.
